heading: cyProof of rent arrears
paragraphs: cyYou must provide proof of how the rent arrears have built up over time. You can upload a rent statement, or create one now.
cyA bank statement will not be accepted. A rent statement must show:
bullets: cyevery date when a payment was supposed to be made
cythe amount that was due on each of those dates
cythe payments that were made, and when they were made
cythe running total of rent arrears
afterBullets: cyIt must cover the time from the first date the defendants missed a payment, or the last 2 years of payments if the first missed payment was more than 2 years ago.
question: cyHow do you want to provide proof of rent arrears?

options.UPLOAD_STATEMENT: cyUpload a rent statement that follows the guidelines
options.LEDGER: cyEnter the rent statement transactions one at a time
options.TABLE: cyCreate a rent statement from the rent due each period
